study: Data4Cyber v3 scenario-family-held-out process-only detector audit
status: exploratory detector and first-alarm explanation benchmark

zenodo_record_metadata_discrepancy.discrepancy_note: The v3 archive README and CHANGES.md report the corrected split (6,768 benign / 7,586 attack-active). The 5,880 / 8,474 landing-page counts equal the earlier S3-all-attack labeling; prefer SHA-verified archive contents and document this record-metadata inconsistency.

limitations: One testbed and six attack-family units; statistical tests are low-powered and exploratory.
S1-alt is grouped with S1 to prevent same-family contamination.
This is process-only and does not reproduce the released twelve-detector IPAL baseline suite.
Row-level metrics do not establish cross-site generalization.
compact_artifact_note: All detector/file/threshold metrics and exact family-level paired-test results are retained. Per-event records are retained for target-eligible attacks and include targets, detection, first-alarm ranks, Hit@K, chance references, stability, and latency. Full event traces and the derived explanation summary are regenerated by running without --compact-output.
